SRC-084:R001.text: Seed the archive hot proof at pack time: measured 2026-09-23 on the live Bridge, the first ensure AFTER a pack runs a full source-tree freshness walk (AUDAPACK 3212ms, ProTrail 2496ms, hot_proof=False); only the next ensure is hot (0.6ms). Every manual ZIP click after a source change pays pack plus one extra full walk in CHECK. PackingService must record the hot proof for the tree it just packed, with exact invalidation.
